whatIs: Supahero is a library of website hero sections: a long grid with hundreds of entries, where each card shows a screenshot of a page's header and links to its own detail page. It's now part of screensdesign and has a search box in the top bar.
It's a good fit when you're about to design the first screen of a landing page and want to see how others solve it: headlines, calls to action, use of color and customer logos.
uses: Comparing several SaaS product heroes before deciding where to put the main button on your landing page.
Looking for examples of heroes with 3D or motion to bring to a designer as a reference.
Checking how headline, subtitle and logo row are combined on the first screen of a developer product.
caveats: It only shows each site's header, not the full page or how it behaves.
The home page is a single grid with no visible categories; to narrow it down you have to use the search.
With the screensdesign integration, some links take you out of the gallery to its app library.
pricingNote: Browsing the gallery is free; the plans on its pricing page are featured slots for advertising a site, starting at $79 for 30 days.
idealFor: People designing the main section of a landing page who are looking for references.
